nl: Put a clean mug in the coffee maker.
steps: Walk to the counter and pick up the mug.
Take the mug to the sink and rinse it.
Carry the clean mug to the coffee maker and put it inside.

nl: Place a heated slice of bread on the plate.
steps: Pick up the bread from the counter.
Put the bread in the microwave and heat it.
Take the bread out and set it on the plate on the table.

nl: Put two pillows on the armchair.
steps: Pick up a pillow from the sofa.
Carry it to the armchair and set it down.
Go back and pick up the second pillow.
Place the second pillow on the armchair.

nl: Examine the book under the light of the floor lamp.
steps: Pick up the book from the desk.
Walk over to the floor lamp.
Turn on the lamp and hold the book up to it.

nl: Put a chilled tomato on the counter.
steps: Take the tomato from the table.
Open the fridge, put the tomato in, close it, wait, and take it out.
Set the cold tomato on the kitchen counter.

nl: Move the remote from the coffee table to the drawer, unless the drawer is full.
steps: Pick up the remote from the coffee table.
Open the drawer next to the TV.
If there is room, put the remote inside and close the drawer.

nl: Put a knife in the sink after using it to cut the apple.
steps: Pick up the knife from the counter.
Slice the apple on the cutting board.
Carry the knife to the sink and drop it in.

nl: Put a washed lettuce in the fridge.
steps: Grab the lettuce from the counter.
Rinse it under the tap.
Open the fridge and place the lettuce on a shelf.

nl: Bring the laptop to the bed and turn on the desk lamp.
steps: Pick up the laptop from the desk.
Carry it to the bed and set it down.
Walk back to the desk and switch on the lamp.

nl: Put a pan with a cooked egg on the dining table.
steps: Pick up the egg from the fridge.
Crack it into the pan on the stove and cook it.
Carry the pan to the dining table and place it there.
